layout_plan.composition: Asymmetric hero: oversized headline top-left with a primary CTA; a live metric/stat tile anchored bottom-right. Not centered.
Modular grid of UNEQUAL tiles — one large feature tile spanning 2 columns/rows, plus smaller tiles (a stat, a short quote, an image, a mini-feature). Varied sizes, never a uniform 3-up.
Wide product/feature band: large mockup or visual on a tinted surface, supporting copy beside it.
Single full-width row: logo strip or 3–4 large stat numerals with small labels.
Full-width CTA band, left-aligned headline + button on a brand-tinted surface.

notes:
TYPOGRAPHY (from the sentry design system — use these EXACT family stacks as the CSS font-family; apply via inline style fontFamily or a Tailwind arbitrary value): display "Rubik, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif" for headings/hero, body "Rubik, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif" for body/labels. Load these Google Fonts via <link> in index.html: Rubik.

Design DNA: Inspired by Linear.app: ultra-premium minimalism, glassy surfaces, layered depth, animated gradients, heavy focus on whitespace and clarity. Oversized headlines, bold sans-serif display fonts, accent colors for interactive cues, dark backgrounds (#010102, #161725) with lavender-blue highlights (#5e6ad2) and muted surface ladders. Subtle shadows, rounded corners, luminous hover/focus effects. All cards float above near-black, cohesive section stacking.. Animation: Framer Motion, gradient transitions, floating card reveals, interactive search bar animations. Interaction: Smooth scroll, hover-glow, tactile button presses, focus-visible, animated input transitions, surface hovering.. Color scheme: dark.

LAYOUT ARCHETYPE: bento — build each page from its layout_plan; do NOT collapse into a centered hero followed by a uniform 3-card grid and footer. A card grid, if used, is at most ONE section among differently-composed sections.

REFERENCE DESIGN SYSTEM: sentry — this is THIS project's design system. USE its palette (tokens.colors above are taken from it) and its font stacks. DISTILL its component treatments (buttons, cards, nav), type scale + tracking, spacing rhythm, and depth/shadow system, and match its level of polish. Do NOT fall back to generic defaults (raw Tailwind gray text, #3B82F6 blue, system fonts) or invent an unrelated purple/dark theme. Brief follows:

version: alpha
name: Sentri-Inspired-design-analysis
description: An inspired interpretation of Sentri's design language — a developer-tools brand built on a deep purple-violet midnight canvas, electric lime accents, and a slightly subversive illustrated personality. The system pairs a custom display sans (chunky, playful, near-condensed) with the open Rubik family for UI copy and Monaco for code, then leans on dark-on-light pricing surfaces, sticker-style mascots, and a single-color CTA hierarchy where black-violet buttons read as the primary action against either polarity.
